result_summary.title: Critical: Form Submission Failure in Customer Portal
result_summary.description: The main contact/support form in the ANZ production Customer Portal is failing to submit for approximately 1,000 users. The form appears to load, but upon clicking submit, nothing happens or it errors out silently. This is completely blocking users from raising support tickets and is a critical business impact.
